If legitimate older receipts need backward compatibility, restrict legacy acceptance to explicitly proven legacy payload schema/history, never arbitrary V0.2 row metadata; do not silently rewrite historical receipts.
Re-run fake D1 loader with the exact synthetic status and expected payload mutations, asserting INVALID/QUOTA_BUDGET_DEFER, and preserve a positive test for authentic V0.2 full-identity receipts.
Keep failure/partial/unknown reservations same-day non-releasing, never infer GraphQL freshness, preserve System1 reserves false/null and no paid tier.
